lines.beaver_en: Hello. Please tell me about the welfare gaps.
lines.learner: 네, 독거노인과 영세민이 지원을 못 받고 있습니다.
lines.en: Yes, elderly people living alone and the poor aren't getting support.
lines.roman: Ne, dokgeonoingwa yeongsemini jiwoneul mot batgo itseumnida.

lines.learner: 오래된 관행 때문에 신청 절차가 너무 어렵습니다.
lines.en: Because of old practices, applying is too hard.
lines.roman: Oraedoen gwanhaeng ttaemune sincheong jeolchaga neomu eoryeopseumnida.

lines.learner: 이주민도 내국인과 동등한 복지를 누려야 합니다.
lines.en: Immigrants should enjoy welfare equal to citizens.
lines.roman: Ijumindo naegugingwa dongdeunghan bokjireul nuryeoya hamnida.

lines.beaver_en: Are you saying the current system isn't fair?
lines.learner: 네, 국적을 막론하고 공정성이 지켜져야 합니다.
lines.en: Yes, fairness must be kept regardless of nationality.
lines.roman: Ne, gukjeogeul mangnonhago gongjeongseongi jikyeojyeoya hamnida.

lines.beaver: 그렇군요. 그런데 현장 문제는 왜 잘 안 바뀝니까?
lines.beaver_en: I see. But why don't problems on the ground get fixed?
lines.beaver_roman: Geureokunyo. Geureonde hyeonjang munjeneun wae jal an bakkwimnikka?
lines.learner: 행정의 위계질서 때문에 현장의 목소리가 묻힙니다.
lines.en: Because of the admin hierarchy, voices from the field get buried.
lines.roman: Haengjeongui wigyejilseo ttaemune hyeonjangui moksoriga muchimnida.

lines.beaver_en: Could you give a specific example?
lines.learner: 어느 독거노인은 혹독한 겨울을 홀로 보냈습니다.
lines.en: One elderly person living alone spent a harsh winter by himself.
lines.roman: Eoneu dokgeonoineun hokdokan gyeoureul hollo bonaetseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: That's unfortunate. What direction should improvement take?
lines.learner: 지역 주민이 힘을 모아 이웃을 찾아가야 합니다.
lines.en: Local residents should join forces and reach out to neighbors.
lines.roman: Jiyeok jumini himeul moa iuseul chajagaya hamnida.

lines.beaver_en: What should change on the officials' side?
lines.en: Outreach support is needed more than strict regulations.

lines.beaver: 일부 사람만 혜택을 받는다는 비판도 있지요.
lines.beaver_en: Some criticize that only a few get benefits.
lines.beaver_roman: Ilbu saramman hyetaegeul banneundaneun bipando itjiyo.
lines.learner: 네, 복지는 특권이 아니라 모두의 권리입니다.
lines.en: Yes, welfare is not a privilege but everyone's right.
lines.roman: Ne, bokjineun teukgwoni anira moduui gwolliimnida.

lines.beaver: 좋은 말씀 감사합니다. 정책에 꼭 반영하겠습니다.
lines.beaver_en: Thank you for your input. We'll reflect it in our policy.
lines.beaver_roman: Joeun malsseum gamsahamnida. Jeongchaege kkok banyeonghagetseumnida.
lines.learner: '소외 없는 복지' 표어가 꼭 현실이 되길 바랍니다.
lines.en: I hope the slogan 'Welfare for all' truly becomes reality.
lines.roman: 'Sooe eomneun bokji' pyoeoga kkok hyeonsiri doegil baramnida.
